title: The Doubling Pass
statement: For every bit string $x$, every natural number $t$ with $t \le |x|$, running the diagonal pairing machine from its initial configuration on $x$ for $2t$ steps yields the configuration in state $0$, with input head at position $t+1$ and output consisting of the first $t$ bits of $x$, each repeated twice.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a bit string and $t \le |x|$.  Running the six-state diagonal
pairing machine from its initial configuration on input $x$ for exactly $2t$
steps yields the configuration in the initial control state with input head
at position $t + 1$ whose output is the first $t$ bits of $x$ with each bit
doubled.
